instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot. In a modern office workspace, the man in the light gray blazer (R1) on the left and the man in the beige polo shirt (R4) on the right celebrate with a high-five, their right hands meeting in the air. The man (R4) holds an open notebook in his left hand. In the background between them, the woman with glasses and a beige sweater vest (R3) smiles. Warm, bright indoor lighting fills the room.
